query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'sourceId',source_id,'mode',mode,'status',status,'recordsSeen',records_seen,'recordsChanged',records_changed,'version',version,'startedAt',started_at,'completedAt',completed_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) FROM ops.source_runs WHERE source_id=$1
